title: Gate 2 pilot read-only runtime
purpose: Implement the owner-authorized GATE2_PILOT_READ_ONLY runtime as an explicit opt-in bounded read-only dependency fan-in overlay above unchanged Gate 1 and byte-identical Gate 0, with complete fresh dependency reconstruction at both privileged timing boundaries and no repository-write, dynamic-request, dataflow, parallel, Gate 3 or Gate 4 capability.

gate2Contract.dependencyIdentity: job_id + request_comment_id + request_sha256 + target_sha under exact repository/authority/request-issue/session/generation scope
gate2Contract.satisfyingTruth: unique Gate1 COMPLETED terminal + valid deterministic Gate2 receipt + authoritative currently valid Gate0 outcome + exact current UTF-8 body SHA-256

invariants: Gate 1 remains the default runtime behavior unless --runtime-profile GATE2_PILOT_READ_ONLY is explicitly selected.
Gate 0 remains byte-identical and is reachable only through the existing four-operation allowlist: pr-snapshot, pr-governor-evidence, run-repository-validation, run-test-profile.
Gate 2 graph declaration is one immutable canonical comment bound to the exact repository, authority issue, request issue, session, generation and immutable Gate 1 grant.
Every graph node and dependency uses the full job_id, request_comment_id, request_sha256 and target_sha identity; job_id-only references are inadmissible.
Gate 2 V1 fan-in is strict AND and deterministic; no OR, quorum, optional, conditional or best-effort dependency exists.
Only a unique Gate 1 COMPLETED terminal with a currently valid authoritative Gate 0 outcome and deterministic Gate 2 body-digest receipt can become SATISFIED.
FAILED, STALE, AMBIGUOUS, deleted, edited or otherwise invalidated predecessor authority never satisfies a dependency.
BLOCKED, RECONCILING, RECOVERY_REQUIRED and GLOBAL_HOLD are never treated as EMPTY; COMPLETE requires every graph node to be SUCCEEDED.
Receipt publication and reconciliation never invoke Gate 0 and cannot replay a completed predecessor.
Boundary A completely rebuilds Gate 2 dependency truth from new stable GitHub reads after durable JOB_SELECTED and before JOB_STARTED; invalidation prevents JOB_STARTED and Gate 0.

Boundary B completely rebuilds Gate 2 dependency truth from new stable GitHub reads after durable JOB_STARTED and immediately before Gate 0; invalidation enters RECOVERY_REQUIRED with zero Gate 0 invocation and zero automatic replay.
The existing Gate 1 final_effect_guard remains mandatory after successful Gate 2 Boundary A and Boundary B validation.
No predecessor output, artifact, summary, code or outcome data can modify descendant request bytes.
Exactly one runtime job is executed at a time; Gate 3 and Gate 4 remain HOLD.
FULL_V6_SECURITY is not claimed by this pilot.
requiredEvidence: Compile and import all tools/ai_jobs modules on the frozen implementation head.
Run all tests/ai_jobs present on the exact baseline/main with zero failures and zero skip/xfail.
Gate 1 regression is exactly 85/85 PASS with skip=0 and xfail=0.
Gate 0 tools/codespace_evidence implementation tree is byte-identical to baseline 5ff235ad8582c17cb3e1979c6582e9950f9c6d48.
Final parent diff contains exactly the four OPS-WP-009 implementation paths plus the six independently authorized QA-WP-014 paths; implementation-owner changes remain restricted to ciOpsAllowedPaths.
Repository governance and tools/validate_repository.py pass on the frozen implementation head.
PR scope and gate pass on the draft pull request.
Independent QA-WP-014 binds to the frozen exact implementation head and runs its full contradictory runtime oracle before readiness.
adversarialTests: Reject malformed or non-canonical graph and receipt envelopes, edited graph comments and wrong author/grant/session/generation/repository/authority/request-issue bindings.
Reject job_id-only, duplicate node identities, duplicate edges, missing dependencies, cross-boundary references and direct/indirect cycles.
Accept each graph bound at its limit and reject payload 65537, nodes 33, edges 65, fan-in 9, fan-out 17 and depth 9.
Kill any strict-AND to OR mutant and prove partial fan-in is not runnable.
Prove COMPLETED without a valid receipt is BINDING_PENDING and cannot satisfy descendants.
Prove FAILED, stale, ambiguous, edited, deleted or invalidated predecessor outcome truth never satisfies.
Prove outcome body mutation under the same comment id invalidates the exact body SHA-256 binding.
Prove Boundary A invalidation publishes no JOB_STARTED and causes zero Gate 0 invocations.
Prove Boundary B invalidation after durable JOB_STARTED results in RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate 0 invocations and zero automatic replay.
Kill shortcuts based on cached RUNNABLE state, cached predecessor projections, cached receipts, or Gate1 final_effect_guard alone.
Prove BLOCKED, RECONCILING and GLOBAL_HOLD cannot enter the Gate 1 empty-close path.
Prove crash after terminal COMPLETED before receipt reconciles a deterministic receipt without Gate 0 replay.
Prove simultaneous runnable nodes retain existing Gate 1 deterministic request ordering.
Prove no arbitrary shell/argv, repository write, automatic Codespace lifecycle, dynamic request creation, dataflow or parallel execution is introduced.
nonGoals: Changing Gate 0 request, execution, outcome, publication, adapter or credential-boundary implementation.
Changing Gate 1 queue, session, GitHub transport, credential boundary or default behavior.
Adding arbitrary shell/argv or automatic Codespace create/start/restart.
Adding dynamic request generation, predecessor-output dataflow, templating or generic workflow semantics.
Adding parallel execution or any Gate 4 behavior.
independentReview: QA-WP-014 owns independent contradictory runtime tests and must not repair tools/ai_jobs implementation files.
QA-WP-014 may PASS only after binding by merge commit to one frozen exact OPS-WP-009 implementation head.
Any OPS-WP-009 implementation-head change invalidates prior QA evidence and requires a complete QA rerun.
The parent implementation may not be merged until the owner/governor final gate in issues 188 and 189 is satisfied.
The final parent scope is the union of four implementation-owner paths and six independently reviewed QA paths; QA paths enter only through the passed child fan-in.
rollback: Revert only the OPS-WP-009 implementation commit/merge affecting tools/ai_jobs/fanin.py, tools/ai_jobs/run.py, tools/ai_jobs/__init__.py and work-packages/OPS-WP-009.json. Gate 0 and all durable GitHub evidence comments remain unchanged.
